description: This PHP source file defines the Flat shipping extension controller for the Opencart admin panel. It provides methods to display the configuration form and handle saving settings for the 'Flat' shipping method. The class handles loading language resources, generating URLs for navigation and form submission, retrieving configuration values, and rendering the view. It also manages permission checks and saves configuration data via the settings model.
